sentences.text:
This application coming on for hearing this day, the co  following:
 ORDER IA No.1070 of 2024, an application moved on behalf of applicant for taking additional documents on record is allowed.
Documents are taken on record.

This second bail application has been filed by applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.184 of 2023 registered at Police Station Bairad, District Shivpuri (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(n),
506 of IPC and Sections 5, 6 of the POCSO Act.

sentences.text: Applicant is in judicial custody since 05-06-2023.
First application of the applicant was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 14th of August, 2023 passed by this Court in MCRC No. 35756 of 2023.
Thereafter, the statements of victim (PW1) and her mother (PW2) have been recorded.

As per the case of prosecution, victim, aged around 18 years and two months, reported to PS Bairad,
District Shivpuri that 5-6 months back, she went to public tap to fetch water.
Her neighbour Amjid Khan (applicant) came there and dragged her behind the school.
Amjid Khan committed rape on her.
Amjid Khan threatened to kill her and her family if she narrates incident to anybody.
Thereafter, on number of occasions, Amjid Khan committed rape on her.

When she missed her menstrual cycle,
her mother enquired from her, so she narrated the incident to her mother and brother Sakir Khan.
Thereafter, she came to report.
On such allegations, PS Bairad registered FIR at Crime No.184 of 2023 for the offences punishable under Section 376, 376(2)(n), 506 of IPC and Sections 5L, 6 of the POCSO Act.
Victim was forwarded for medico-legal examination.
She underwent abortion of fetus aged about 16 weeks.
Applicant was arrested on 05-06-2023, he is in custody ever since.
On completion of investigation, Final Report was submitted.
Trial is underway.
Victim was examined on 29-11-2023 and her mother was examined on 19-12-2023 before the Trial Court.
Learned Counsel for the applicant, in addition to the grounds mentioned in the application, submits that it is a case of romantic relationship between two young persons.
Victim has made allegation of rape under pressure of her family when she missed her menstrual cycle.
Applicant was aged around 20 years whereas victim was aged around 20 years at the time of incident as per statements of Victim (PW1) and her mother (PW2).
Learned Counsel further submits that the victim and her mother did not support the prosecution in their evidence.
Material witnesses have been examined.
Only witnesses with regard to investigation are yet to be examined.
There is no likelihood of tampering with the evidence.
Applicant is an agriculturist by profession.
There is no likelihood of his absconsion leaving his family and home.
Jail incarceration on false allegation is causing hardship to applicant.
Trial would take time to conclude.
Therefore, applicant may be extended the benefit of bail.
Per contra, learned Counsel for the State opposes the bail application on the ground of gravity of alleged offence and cites one more criminal case against applicant.
Learned Counsel referring to DNA report, submits that applicant was found to be biological father of fetus aborted by victim.
In reply, learned Counsel for the applicant submits that no offence of similar nature is reported against him.
Another matter is pending for trial and applicant has never been convicted.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.

Considering the arguments advanced by both the parties and overall circumstances of the case, regard being had to the young age of applicant, but without commenting on merits of the case, this Court is inclined to release the applicants on bail.
Thus, the application is allowed.
